title: Volunteer teachers’ sit-in at the Treasury
organizer: Volunteer teachers / coordination named in reporting; exact formal organizer unclear
participants_original: Described as many; no count reported
threshold_50_evidence: The opened report describes many participants but does not quantify the gathering; 4,660 denotes teachers assigned nationally, not attendance.

start_date.summary: The body dates the teachers’ demonstration to Monday, 7 December 2020.

location.summary: Reported as a demonstration before the Treasury in Brazzaville.

demands.summary: The teachers demanded payment of six months of bursary/remuneration.

participants.summary: The body says many took part but provides no attendance figure; the workforce figure is not treated as a crowd count.

threshold_50.summary: No numeric attendance or bounded lower estimate establishes 50.

notes: A separate December event, not merged with the October 1 sit-in. Recurrence of similar demands does not by itself establish uninterrupted mobilization.
open_questions: Can a local report quantify attendance on 7 December?
Was there a follow-up action in January 2021?

title: Anti-curfew demonstration reported in Brazzaville neighborhoods
threshold_50_evidence: The article reports youth demonstrations but gives no number by neighborhood or city.

start_date.summary: The page, published 1 January 2021, describes action around 21:00 on 31 December 2020.

location.summary: The account references Brazzaville neighborhoods; no precise neighborhood is named.

demands.summary: Demonstrators opposed the curfew and associated COVID restrictions.

threshold_50.summary: At least 50 participants in Brazzaville is not established.

notes: Reported separately from Pointe-Noire; do not pool city counts. Publication falls on 1 January while action date is 31 December.
open_questions: Can a local source establish the Brazzaville crowd size and end time?
Did the action continue after midnight or on 1 January?
